title: The Battery Line Wang Chuanfu Built by Hand Instead of Buying
conflicts: Start-up money: Fortune 2009 says some $300,000 from relatives; China Daily (Gasgoo reprint) 2.5 million yuan, consistent; CNN 'a relative'; Wikipedia's 250,000-yuan cousin loan is not in the CNN source it cites; CnEVPost gives inconsistent figures. Story uses Fortune's $300,000. Founding: Wang (2024) dates the start of work to 18 November 1994 and the licence to early 1995; story gives both. Market position by 2000-2002 varies (biggest / one of largest / top three / top four); story uses the HBS 'top four in each of three technologies by 2002' cited by Fortune.
notes: Fortune and BusinessWeek are cited via Internet Archive copies (live URLs 503/gone). The 36Kr source is an English translation of Wang's 30th-anniversary speech, so the short quotation is the translation's wording. The Gasgoo page loads intermittently; nothing in the story depends on it alone. Stance: complicates (Tagore on valuing people beyond their usefulness), written so as not to accuse BYD of anything the sources do not report.
